en.label: Onion Skin
tooltip: Open the manager when you want to compare a pose with nearby frames without leaving the camera view.
Add the character meshes, enable onion skins, then scrub through the poses you want to compare.
Right-click to choose the pose style, colors, sampling, and viewport behavior.

en.label: Enable Onion Skin
tooltip: Show nearby poses while checking spacing, silhouettes, and arcs.
